name: Aizen
source:
"I will do whatever it takes to protect those I love."

Aizen, the Emperor of Jerille. The calm and collected leader of one of the largest empires in Remoire. You find yourself fated to this man after a surprising encounter in the capital. Your lives get much more complicated as your fates connect.

Your mark is on his hand. The very hand that he is hesitant to extend to you. The hand that holds so much responsibility, to match a heart that holds so much turmoil.  Will you be able to keep yourself alive amidst the horrors of the realm of nobles? Will he be able to protect you with the hands burdened by an empire?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eternallovestudios/shattered-souls-a-dark-fantasy-isekai-otome]Kickstarter[/url]]
